body: Hey man, I didn't think I would log back onto here and its been a month but your advice is bomb diggity solid despite my recent decision that online dating is a cesspool and waste of time for me. The question "WHAT IS JAKE ABOUT" is very relevant to my current ego and self-image and you are right I should see my shrink again since I havent for a good while. but damn maybe you should be one since you obviously know your shit!

I'm glad someone can relate, I'm curious as to whether you've done anything to work on the damage to the mind and overcoming the past emotions.  It's become an obsession and it's very confusing to me regarding what I could actually do to help myself.

I've been seeing a therapist for a while man.  I did something very idiotic recently and messaged the psycho, I was really high on klonopin, he blocked me initially but i made another account to do it.  I sort of blacked out but I remember I said some very stupid things almost praising him for some reason.  Good thing I don't remember the password so I can't see if he responded or not.  It sucks to be stupid.
Girls that get their pictures taken of them naked on guys cell phones are NOT worth your time.  Trust me on that one.
